meta: commit b2d04e166. One case per line. case: transmitter/neighbor kind/facing/side/order. order=neighbor_first places the neighbor then the transmitter (T.onAdded refreshes), order=transmitter_first places the transmitter, waits 2 ticks, then the neighbor (neighborChanged). Machines are placed by a player at the given facing (facing_real is the tile's). Single neighbor cases carry placements=[{side, kind, facing}]; combos carry several. After 6 ticks: t (the transmitter state: cur_t, cur_a, all, raw, types, can_connect, can_connect_to_acceptor, can_extract, can_insert, caps (the capability found at each side by the AcceptorCache, the world input of the port), has_pull, reactive, powered, redstone_set, activated), n (each neighbor that is a transmitter, by side). Sides are in Direction order: down, up, north, south, west, east.
